value: The first device record ever to reach instance-space disk. liveness.py: atomic write (temp-then-os.replace, same dir) + the read face carrying the ruled 5s at its ONE class-space address (liveness.py:39) — absent/torn is DEAD with the lack named, never a raise. beat() gained the touch via construction-time liveness_home (the runner passes instance_home(); an anonymous in-process device — every pure-physics proof — has no device space and writes nothing, which is how the 8 pre-existing teeth stayed byte-untouched). __main__.py: the 46-line thin runner at the ruled 1s cadence, signal-clean, importing nothing but its own package. Live fire: separate-process reads watched last_run advance (beats 2->10, pid riding), and 6s after SIGTERM the verdict fell DEAD with the corpse's record returned whole — the crashed-loop detector working exactly as told. 13/13 teeth green twice + netns seal; verdict artifact verdict-20260809T110841-c93aee8392c8.json answers the chart (chain orient->validate 20260809, all deposited). The runner is session-mortal: the host-seam unit file keeping it alive across sessions stays the named IOU, out of these bounds.

The cast string omitted TICKETME — the chokepoint's own conformance check refused it (MalformedWorkflow, registered path THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> PROVED). Restored the missing stage with the cursor untouched at [THINKME]; the /sorted door now runs this parser at cast, so a drift like this dies there for every ticket cast after 2026-08-03.

On each pass the ground loop writes a record in its own device space (~/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/<instance>/) carrying: when it last ran, its state, and its pid. The write is part of the pass, not a separate concern.

Cast with the cursor at [BUILDME], corrected to [THINKME] within the hour. A cursor AT a stage means that stage was ENTERED — superclaude-starts-itself rests at [PROVEME] with its BUILDME gate already satisfied — so [BUILDME] on a freshly cast leaf claims a crossing that never rode the chokepoint. It cannot have: since ticket buildme-rides-the-chart (2026-07-29) the entry gate refuses a BUILDME crossing unless a berthed validate packet claims the ticket, and a census of all 89 berths finds ZERO claiming any ticket in this family. Hand-writing the cursor forward is precisely the hand-edit of a record of truth that transitions.emit exists to prevent (Law 4). The stage is reachable only by /chart, then the door.

THE STALENESS THRESHOLD IS 5 SECONDS — five missed ticks at the ruled once-per-second cadence. Ruled by Akien 2026-07-31. Three times the interval is the standard liveness heuristic; five gives slack for a loaded box without anyone noticing the lag. LIVE = last-run within 5s. DEAD = last-run older than 5s, whatever the file says about state, whatever pid it names. A crashed loop leaves the file behind but STOPS ADVANCING THE TIMESTAMP — that is the whole detector, and it is Akien's, present in the design from the first telling.

The write happens on EVERY pass, and the pass is once per second, so the write must cost near nothing and must be atomic — a reader inside a 5s window must never see a torn record and conclude DEAD. Write-temp-then-rename, the same discipline as the projector's append door.
